mechanism: Methylprednisolone may reduce pyrazinamide efficacy and increase hyperuricemia risk; pyrazinamide can elevate uric acid levels which may be worsened by corticosteroid-induced metabolic effects.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and gout symptoms; consider alternative antimicrobial agents if possible; ensure adequate monitoring of TB treatment response and adjust immunosuppression dosing as needed.
